Dear Fedor,

Thank you for your message and for sharing the details of your request. We appreciate your interest in collaborating with us.

However, please note that our bookings for the requested dates (November 2026 , mid-February 2027) are not yet open. We would be happy to assist you once our availability is confirmed.

We recommend reaching out to us in September or October, and we will gladly provide suitable options that match your criteria at that time.

Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to working with you.
